GHSA-8hcx-xvww-6c6h withdrawn_at is null. None of these first-party records bind the CVE to a file or hunk.

GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=1 git diff --name-status 2.4.7-p5 2.4.7-p6 on clone /home/hanqing/agents/ai-slop/.ai-slop/state/repos/magento_magento2 shows several distinct access-control or data-exposure candidates in the same aggregate security release: app/code/Magento/Cms/Ui/Component/DataProvider.php (admin CMS listing ACL), app/code/Magento/Email/Model/Template/Filter.php (block cache_key; 2.4.8-p1 notes name this as CVE-2025-47110), app/code/Magento/Quote/Plugin/ValidateQuoteOrigOrder.php plus Quote di.xml (origOrderId ownership; release notes call this restricted async override of prior customer orders), Magento/Downloadable etc/graphql|webapi_rest|webapi_soap/events.xml (IsAllowedGuestCheckoutObserver on API areas), and Magento/WebapiAsync Controller/Rest/Asynchronous/InputParamsResolver.php (release notes call this API performance). 2.4.6-p10..2.4.6-p11 and 2.4.5-p12..2.4.5-p13 additionally add Magento/Checkout/Plugin/Api/VerifyIsGuestCheckoutEnabledBefore*.php already present on 2.4.7-p5.

2.4.8..2.4.8-p1 additionally deletes unauthenticated GraphQL Query.allCustomerGroups / allCartRules / allCatalogRules (and related resolvers). Those endpoints exist only on tag 2.4.8 (commit 94b8544e82fd84d1443060cddb5481b7fd462de2) and are absent from 2.4.7-p5, 2.4.7-p6, and 2.4.6-p10. Damien Retzinger publicly described that 2.4.8-only leak; Adobe KB https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-cloud-kcs/kbarticles/ka-27159 (LYNX-839, 2.4.8-only hotfix, no CVE id) matches it. Binding CVE-2025-49550 to that GraphQL surface would contradict the advisory's 2.4.7-p5/2.4.6-p10/2.4.5-p12 range and the CVSS UI:R (the GraphQL queries are unauthenticated with no victim click). Selecting any other candidate hunk would likewise be inference.

No unique vulnerable hunk is identified for CVE-2025-49550, so no smallest surviving public first-writer can be selected. Promoting a packaging commit, a 2.4.8 GraphQL introducer, or any other AI- or patch-shaped lead would invert the protocol (vulnerability first, BIC second).
Without an atomic BIC SHA, there is no immediate-parent tree on which absence of the vulnerable lines can be verified.

CVE-2025-49550 is a real, non-withdrawn Adobe CNA record (PUBLISHED). GitHub withdrawn_at is not authoritative and is in any case null on GHSA-8hcx-xvww-6c6h. FALSE_POSITIVE is not available.
Authoritative sources establish only CWE-863, PR:N, UI:R, C:L, no-auth/no-admin, researcher Damien Retzinger. They do not name a protected resource, request source, authorization decision, or sink.

The APSB25-50 public trees contain multiple independent authorization/confidentiality hunks. Adobe's own 2.4.8-p1 notes already assign the email-template Filter.php cache_key change to CVE-2025-47110 and the Catalog Helper Category.php escapeUrl change to VULN-31547, leaving CMS DataProvider, Quote origOrder validation, Downloadable API guest-checkout observers, WebapiAsync InputParamsResolver, and the 2.4.8-only GraphQL personalization queries as competing leftovers for several remaining CVEs including CVE-2025-49550 and CVE-2025-49549.

Damien Retzinger's public 2.4.8 GraphQL writeups (allCustomerGroups / allCartRules / allCatalogRules) and Adobe KB ka-27159 (LYNX-839, 2.4.8-only) match a confidentiality leak that 2.4.8-p1 deletes, but that surface is absent from 2.4.7-p5/2.4.7-p6/2.4.6-p10 and is exploitable without user interaction. It therefore cannot be promoted to CVE-2025-49550's BIC without discarding the vendor affected-range and UI:R vector.

Fixed Magento packaging commits are single-parent squash aggregates whose parents are older unrelated merges, not the previous p-tag. Public history has no finer per-CVE members. No BIC-local author, committer, trailer, or generator marker can be judged.
remaining_gap: Need a first-party Adobe/Magento CVE-to-component map (isolated patch, VULN/LYNX id, commit message, or advisory note) that names the exact CVE-2025-49550 sink and direct-fix hunk in public magento/magento2 history. Until that binding exists, do not treat LYNX-839 GraphQL deletions, CMS DataProvider ACL, Quote origOrder checks, Downloadable guest-checkout observers, or any other APSB25-50 hunk as this CVE.
